text: Nursery set. Price: $20.99. Includes 1 woman figure and 1 baby figure. Accessories: baby cot, cloth blanket, changing unit with play bow, floor lamp, rocking chair, carpet, trash can, potty, motoric toy, standing figure, teddy bear, baby bib, baby bottle, 2 glasses, cosmetic bottle, tube, and 2 sets of baby toys.

Bedroom with Sewing Corner set. Price: $28.99. Includes 1 woman figure. Accessories: double bed with bedside lamps, wardrobe with mirror, 5 coat hangers, sewing table, chair, coat rack, ironing board, iron, sewing machine with foot pedal, 2 fabrics, 2 threads, scissors, pin cushion, pattern, storage box. Also includes clothing items: neckholder top, plate skirt, mini skirt, dress, evening dress, neckholder dress, bangle, clutch, shoulder bag, and handbag.

Bathroom with Tub set. Price: $22.99. Includes 1 man figure. Accessories: washbasin with basin and mirror, bathtub, toilet with toilet paper holder and brush, children's toilet seat, stool, 2 baskets, carpet, lipstick, mascara, powder brush, comb, hairbrush, 2 cups, 2 tubes, 2 toothbrushes, spray bottle, bottle, scissors, 2 cosmetic bottles, hairdryer, razor, scales, bath towel, bath duck, 2 towels, sponge, and bath slippers.

Demeter figure (Greek mythology). Price: $4.99. Mother Goddess of fertility, grain, seeds and seasons. Comes with golden sickle, wheat ear, fruits and a lamb. Available in Greek version with Greek texts only.

Camping Adventure Carry Case. Price: $11.24. Outdoor adventure set including 2 camper figures, tent, canoe, campfire, backpacks, binoculars, fish and other accessories. When playtime is over, all pieces store inside the carry case.

Artemis figure (Greek mythology). Price: $4.99. Goddess of hunting, the forest, the moon, women and children. Comes with bow, arrow and the Kerynite Doe. Available in Greek version with Greek texts only.

Athena figure (Greek mythology). Price: $4.99. Greek goddess of wisdom, strategy, battle and art. Wears a toga and golden helmet, and comes with shield, spear, owl and snake. Available in Greek version with Greek texts only.
Zeus figure (Greek mythology). Price: $4.99. Father of the gods. Comes with sceptre, lightning bundle and an eagle.
PLAYMOBIL-FunPark Bus. Price: $40.00. Large bus that seats a driver and 11 passengers. Features a spacious luggage compartment, removable roof, bus stop and tow hitch.
Police Roadblock set. Price: $13.99. Includes police figures with police dog and a full set of police equipment.
Modern Living Room set. Price: $14.99. Furnished with a two-part couch, modern coffee table and a sideboard with TV.
Modern Bedroom set. Price: $13.24. Cosy bedroom set with comfortable blanket and bedroom furniture.
Modern Designer Kitchen set. Price: $14.99. Equipped with a modern cook island, large fridge, oven, microwave and dishwasher. Includes food items and functional kitchen equipment.
Child with Monster figure (Special Plus). Price: $2.99. Includes child figure, monster and funny accessories.
Man with E-Scooter figure (Special Plus). Price: $2.99. Includes man figure with e-scooter and charging station.
Formal Dining Room set. Price: $14.99. Nostalgic living room furnishings including sofa, bookcase, large table, four chairs, crockery and many extras for family gatherings.
Napoleon historical figure. Price: $5.99. Figure of French commander and emperor Napoleon Bonaparte in uniform with a two-pointed hat and his white steed Vizir.
Novelmore Knights Set (3-pack). Price: $10.99. Three Novelmore knight figures to expand and grow your Novelmore army.
Bicycle Excursion figure set. Price: $3.37. Figures on a cycling excursion, includes bike helmets.
Police Off-Road Car with Jewel Thief set. Price: $29.99. Action chase set including a police off-road vehicle and a robber on a motocross bike with a secret treasure hiding place.
Achilles and Patroclus with Chariot set (Greek mythology). Price: $17.99. Two Greek heroes with the chariot of Achilles preparing for battle outside the walls of Troy.
Adventure Playground set. Price: $26.24. Outdoor playground including a playhouse accessible via climbing net or rock wall, slide, tire swing, crocodile seesaw and sand toys.
Hephaestus figure (Greek mythology). Price: $4.99. God of fire and forging. Comes with hammer, anvil, forging tongs, shovel and shield.
Ares figure (Greek mythology). Price: $4.99. God of war. Comes with sword, helmet, shield, lance and black dog. Available in Greek version only.
Plant Scientist Gift Set. Price: $5.99. Includes plant scientist figure with many forest animals.
Woman with Cats figure (Special Plus). Price: $2.99. Woman figure with cats.
Policeman with Dog figure (Special Plus). Price: $4.99. Policeman figure with sniffer dog and hidden loot.
Pizza Chef figure (Special Plus). Price: $3.37. Pizza chef figure with pizza shovel and other accessories.
Novelmore - Medieval Jousting Area set. Price: $13.99. Novelmore knight Francis Forthwind training for the jousting tournament with horse and lance.
Starter Pack Rescue with Balance Racer. Price: $11.24. Paramedic figure rushing to the aid of an inline skater. Great starter set for younger children.
Medical Helicopter set. Price: $29.99. Modern medical rescue helicopter with movable rotor blades. Includes rescue stretcher to transport an injured hiker figure.
Campsite with Campfire set. Price: $16.49. Family camping vacation set with a large tent, campfire and family figures enjoying time together outdoors.
Child with Kart figure (Special Plus). Price: $3.37. Child figure with kart and helmet.
